meta.title: Grant Migration: Export, Translate, Apply Top-Down, Verify

views.label: Export as admin
views.note: information_schema filters to what the querying principal can see — run this as a metastore admin or export a silent subset.

views.label: Top-down, not table-first
views.note: Catalog and schema grants land before table-level exceptions, or some operations fail with confusing permission errors.

views.label: Diff before trusting it
views.note: The verify step is what catches a translation gap before a user does.

cards.title: The export step is the one that silently lies
items: information_schema automatically filters to what the querying principal can already see
A clean-looking export from a non-admin is a subset, not the whole grant set
Sanity-check the exported grant count against the object count before trusting it

cards.title: Apply order is not optional
items: Grant catalog, then schema, then table — the wrong order fails with confusing permission errors
Reserve table-level grants for genuine exceptions; they're the ones that get missed and drift
Use Unity Catalog groups as grantees everywhere, not individual users

cards.title: Verify closes the loop
items: dbxmig verify diffs target grants against the source export directly
A missing grant here is a support ticket weeks after cutover, not a build failure today
Keep an ownership group per domain, separate from the read-access group
